conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

moves.note: Blend broad index and quality tech

plan: Trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, and MUU to 3% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim METU to 2% to reduce high-beta single name concentration.
Trim SPY to 20% to cure the concentration breach and align with balanced limits.
Trim CRWD to 8% to reduce concentration and rebalance the portfolio.
Add to QQQI, targeting 10%, to blend broad index and quality tech for risk-first growth.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index, quality tech, and a small amount of leveraged exposure. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs decay daily. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the higher risk.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, and MUU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell METU, CRWD, and SNOW to zero to cut high-beta single names.
Add to QQQI, targeting 40%, to rotate heavily into income ETFs for steady distributions.
Trim SPY to 20% to cure the concentration breach and add broad market stability.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure, rotating into income and broad index ETFs. While prioritizing low drawdown and distributions, remember distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
